name: Winter ordeal
look: Winter ordeal, the winter shadow of heaven: a xianxia art where a cultivator turns winter into night: the whole night sky above the enemy cracks like a pane of black glass, and its pieces fall as black snow. Every flake is not ice but a small shard of the sky's own shadow, the colour of night, with only a thin cold violet-white edge where starlight catches it; caught in a palm it cuts and hurts. In the cracks of the sky an eye seems about to open. The snow screams as it falls, faster and denser. The mood is silent, cold and final: black on black, a few cold glints, no warm colour and no white snow at all.
subject: black snow

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the cracked pane of night sky alone, as it hangs over the enemy at its fullest: a wide, slightly curved dark pane, wider than the enemy is tall, broken into about twelve angular shards by thin violet-white cracks that meet at a closed eye in its middle; no snow, no glow, no specks

parts.name: FLAKE
parts.text: one black six-pointed flake of night with a one-pixel cold violet-white edge, small, as it falls (its shapes and angles are on a sheet of their own)

parts.name: EYE
parts.text: the eye the cracks draw in the pane, alone: almond-shaped, its lids made of crack lines of violet-white light
forms: a sliver open, a thread of light
half open, the dark beneath showing

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: black specks, tiny violet-white glints, a thin pale crack line, a puff of dark frost where a flake lands, a cold sparkle

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the cold violet-white glow of the cracks, the eye and the flakes' edges, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes: the night pane, its shards and the black flakes, opaque, with no glow and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: specks, glints, crack lines and frost puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the cold violet-white light of the cracks and the flake edges, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: LINES
layers.text: line art only, for the programmer: one-pixel lines in pure red (#ff0000), nothing else and no glow. Draw the crack network as lines, the outline of every shard of the pane, the eye's two lids as two curves, and for every falling flake a dotted red line from the pane to where the flake is now. The lines lie exactly on the shapes of the SOLID row of the same frame.

rules: The snow is black, the colour of night, with only a thin cold violet-white edge: never white snow, never a warm colour.
The figure is the enemy: the pane hangs above it, the eye looks down at it and the snow falls on it. Do not draw the figure.
The pane keeps MAIN's size and its twelve shards until its row says it breaks; shards that fall are gone from the pane.
Pure red (#ff0000) appears only in the LINES row, and the LINES row uses nothing else.
Keep the colours of the second image's palette: no outline in black, no gradients wider than a few pixels.
